title: CurAItion Story Candidate Handoff
description: Output of the cultural-scout skill. Consumed by renderer skills (longform-post, tweet-thread, carousel-producer, digest). All facts must be library-sourced (source_scope: 'library') and citation-backed.

scope_verification.description: Proof the library-only scope contract held. A candidate is INVALID only if a HARD GATE failed: source_scope !== 'library', effective_org_id_null !== true, or athlete_canary_count > 0. external_safe is a recorded data-quality note, NOT a gate.

effective_org_id_null.description: HARD GATE: envelope.scope.effective_org_id === null — must be true

external_safe.description: RECORDED, not gated: envelope.external_safe (a data-quality verdict, not a leak signal). May be false on library when one curator/seed org dominates — note it and proceed.

representativeness_note.description: When external_safe is false, the envelope.external_safe_reasons[0] explaining the data-quality caveat (e.g. single-org concentration).

athlete_canary_count.description: HARD GATE: items returned for the athlete-leak probe — must be 0

headline_hypothesis.description: The angle in one line. Not a final headline.

lead_domain.description: The single domain this candidate leads with — must be on the SKILL.md eligible roster. REQUIRED: the next run's cooldown reads this field from the last 7 handoffs to avoid repeating a domain. Without it the cooldown silently no-ops.

domains.description: Library domains this signal spans, including lead_domain. 2+ is the strong case.

metrics.description: trend delta %, quality scores, source counts, etc.

promotional_flag.description: true if the source content is intent_class sale/product_benefit — should lower rank

the_depth_90d.description: The 90d+ connection that gives the story depth. The CurAItion signature move.

why_now.description: Web-grounded causal hypothesis from why_now_analysis + WebSearch.

why_it_matters.description: Interpretive lift, explicitly derived from the cited facts above.

surprise_factor.description: What makes this non-obvious / why a human team would miss it.

cross_domain_bridge.description: 0-3: a surprising connection between 2+ eligible domains.

time_depth.description: 0-2: timeless rhyme — echoes something old, NOT a news escalation.

surprise.description: 0-3: curiosity / distinctiveness, the 'I never knew that' factor. The primary signal.

rarity_weight.description: 0-3: computed at run time from the lead domain's share of the live eligible pool (see scoring.rarity_weights). Replaces the retired flat breadth bonus, which was worth +1, applied to 10 of the 11 swept domains including the largest, and had no field here at all — so it was both inert and invisible.

evidence.description: 0-2: citation density and source count RELATIVE TO THAT DOMAIN'S OWN NORM. Absolute density re-imports the volume bias the per-domain quota removes.

cooldown.description: 0 to -3: penalty when lead_domain was selected recently (-3 within 3 days, -1 at 4-7 days). Derived by reading the previous 7 handoffs.

penalties.description: Hard penalties: current-affairs/geopolitics -5, markets/crypto -5, big-tech-as-news -4, client brand lane as lead -5, promotional -3, single-domain no bridge -1.

total.description: Sum of the above. Maximum 13 before modifiers and penalties.

selected_candidate_id.description: The top pick for today's one-story-many-formats run.

scoring.description: How this run's domain weighting was derived. Recorded so a reader can see WHY the day's pick won, and so a repetitive streak is auditable rather than mysterious.

rarity_weights.description: Per-eligible-domain { share, weight } computed at run time from the live domain_registry returned by Canary A. Never hardcoded: culture grew 2.9x between 2026-06-19 and 2026-07-27 while food grew 1.1x, so any fixed table stops discriminating within weeks.

share.description: domain content_count / total across the eligible roster.

cooldown_source.description: Which prior handoffs informed the cooldown, or 'no history' on a first run.

domains_swept.description: Eligible domains actually queried this run — one get_cited_themes call each.

domains_empty.description: Eligible domains that returned nothing usable. Recorded explicitly; a domain must never be dropped silently.

selection_note.description: Required when the selected candidate's lead_domain has rarity_weight 0 (the largest eligible domain) AND was also selected within the last 7 days — the exact repetition this rubric exists to prevent. Not forbidden, but it must be justified in writing.
